test_cases.description: ensureLeadingSlash should prepend a slash to any bare multi-segment path, not just single-word slugs the visible tests use
ensureLeadingSlash should correctly handle a single non-slash character input
ensureLeadingSlash should prepend slash to whitespace-only strings since they don't start with '/'
ensureLeadingSlash should not alter trailing slashes — it only concerns itself with the leading character
test_cases.input_description: Strings with trailing slashes like 'cartographer/' and '/cartographer/'
test_cases.expected_output_description: '/cartographer/' preserved as-is when already has leading slash; 'cartographer/' becomes '/cartographer/'

test_cases.description: ensureLeadingSlash should handle numeric string inputs that don't start with slash
ensureLeadingSlash should handle strings with special characters, only caring about the leading slash
test_cases.input_description: Strings with special chars like '#hash' and '?query=1'

test_cases.description: ensureLeadingSlash should not strip or modify triple slashes — any string starting with '/' is returned unchanged
ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST must contain entries for every defined StepId — no step can be omitted
assertions: const expectedIds = ['home','cartographer','constrain','ledger','pact','advocate','arbiter','baton','sentinel','chronicler','stigmergy','apprentice','kindex']; const actualIds = ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.map(e => e.stepId); expectedIds.forEach(id => expect(actualIds).toContain(id))

test_cases.description: ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST must contain all 13 expected human-readable labels from the contract's StepLabel enum
assertions: const expectedLabels = ['Home','Step 0 — Cartographer','Step 1a — Constrain','Step 1b — Ledger','Step 2a — Pact','Step 2b — Advocate','Step 3 — Arbiter','Step 4 — Baton','Step 5a — Sentinel','Step 5b — Chronicler','Step 5c — Stigmergy','Step 6 — Apprentice','Step 7 — Kindex']; const actualLabels = ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.map(e => e.label); expectedLabels.forEach(l => expect(actualLabels).toContain(l))

test_cases.description: ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST must contain all 13 expected slug values from the RouteSlug enum
assertions: const expectedSlugs = ['/','cartographer','constrain','ledger','pact','advocate','arbiter','baton','sentinel','chronicler','stigmergy','apprentice','kindex'].map(s => s.startsWith('/') ? s : '/' + s); const actualSlugs = ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.map(e => e.slug); expectedSlugs.forEach(s => expect(actualSlugs).toContain(s))

test_cases.description: Each RouteEntry in ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST must have exactly the three required fields: stepId, slug, label
assertions: ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.forEach(entry => { expect(entry).toHaveProperty('stepId'); expect(entry).toHaveProperty('slug'); expect(entry).toHaveProperty('label'); expect(typeof entry.stepId).toBe('string'); expect(typeof entry.slug).toBe('string'); expect(typeof entry.label).toBe('string') })

test_cases.description: Each entry's slug should correspond to its stepId — e.g., stepId 'cartographer' maps to slug '/cartographer'
assertions: ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.forEach(entry => { if (entry.stepId === 'home') { expect(entry.slug).toBe('/') } else { expect(entry.slug).toBe('/' + entry.stepId) } })

test_cases.description: ROUTE_SLUG_MAP must have exactly the 13 StepId keys defined in the contract
assertions: const expectedKeys = ['home','cartographer','constrain','ledger','pact','advocate','arbiter','baton','sentinel','chronicler','stigmergy','apprentice','kindex']; const actualKeys = Object.keys(ROUTE_SLUG_MAP); expect(actualKeys.sort()).toEqual(expectedKeys.sort()); expect(actualKeys.length).toBe(13)

test_cases.description: ROUTE_SLUG_MAP.home must be '/' — the root path
ROUTE_SLUG_MAP values must match the expected slug for each stepId, not be arbitrary strings that happen to start with '/'
Each stepId must map to its correct label — not just any label from the set
assertions: const mapping = Object.fromEntries(ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.map(e => [e.stepId, e.label])); expect(mapping.home).toBe('Home'); expect(mapping.cartographer).toBe('Step 0 — Cartographer'); expect(mapping.constrain).toBe('Step 1a — Constrain'); expect(mapping.ledger).toBe('Step 1b — Ledger'); expect(mapping.pact).toBe('Step 2a — Pact'); expect(mapping.advocate).toBe('Step 2b — Advocate'); expect(mapping.arbiter).toBe('Step 3 — Arbiter'); expect(mapping.baton).toBe('Step 4 — Baton'); expect(mapping.sentinel).toBe('Step 5a — Sentinel'); expect(mapping.chronicler).toBe('Step 5b — Chronicler'); expect(mapping.stigmergy).toBe('Step 5c — Stigmergy'); expect(mapping.apprentice).toBe('Step 6 — Apprentice'); expect(mapping.kindex).toBe('Step 7 — Kindex')

test_cases.description: ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST entries must follow the pipeline ordering: home, cartographer, constrain, ledger, pact, advocate, arbiter, baton, sentinel, chronicler, stigmergy, apprentice, kindex
assertions: const expectedOrder = ['home','cartographer','constrain','ledger','pact','advocate','arbiter','baton','sentinel','chronicler','stigmergy','apprentice','kindex']; const actualOrder = ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.map(e => e.stepId); expect(actualOrder).toEqual(expectedOrder)

test_cases.description: All labels across ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST must be unique — no two entries share the same label
assertions: const labels = ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.map(e => e.label); const uniqueLabels = new Set(labels); expect(uniqueLabels.size).toBe(labels.length)

test_cases.description: All stepIds across ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST must be unique — no duplicated step identifiers
assertions: const ids = ROUTE_ENTRY_LIST.map(e => e.stepId); const uniqueIds = new Set(ids); expect(uniqueIds.size).toBe(ids.length)

test_cases.description: getNavLinkClassName must return a string type for both active and inactive — not an object, array, or undefined
getNavLinkClassName should not return strings containing 'undefined' which can happen from bad template literals
Active NavLink className should contain a visual emphasis class like font-bold or font-semibold to distinguish it
assertions: const active = getNavLinkClassName(true); expect(active.includes('font-bold') || active.includes('font-semibold') || active.includes('bg-') || active.includes('text-')).toBe(true)

test_cases.description: Non-home NavLinks should NOT have the end prop — only the home link needs it to prevent overly broad matching
assertions: The non-home NavLink anchors should not have end prop behavior that would break sub-route matching

test_cases.description: Sidebar should render with a semantic nav element or be contained within proper navigation markup
assertions: Sidebar renders a nav element or aside element for semantic navigation

test_cases.description: Each non-home child route path must exactly match entry.slug.slice(1) — verifying the contract's path derivation rule
assertions: Non-home child routes have paths that are the slug without the leading slash

test_cases.description: The parent route must have path '/' — not an empty string or undefined
Every child route must have a defined element property — no missing or undefined page components
assertions: All 13 child routes have truthy element properties

test_cases.description: ensureLeadingSlash must be idempotent when applied to every actual slug in ROUTE_SLUG_MAP
ensureLeadingSlash applied to any slug from ROUTE_SLUG_MAP should return it unchanged since all slugs already have leading slashes
Non-home slugs in ROUTE_SLUG_MAP should not have trailing slashes — they are clean path segments
